children: LandBridge said its subsidiary plans, subject to market conditions, to privately place $100M of additional 6.250% senior notes due 2030, fungible with its existing $500M series. Net proceeds will repay borrowings under its revolving credit facility.
Adds fixed-rate debt; size and rate inform funding costs and leverage.
Fungibility may support pricing/liquidity and benchmark spread.
Terming out short-term debt can ease liquidity risk and interest costs.
Institutional demand will drive pricing; no immediate equity impact.
Minimizes structural subordination/complexity; pricing tied to current notes.

This is a follow-on to an existing 2030 notes issuance, signaling continued balance-sheet terming and access to debt markets. A larger catalyst would be final pricing, upsizing, or disclosed impact on interest expense/leverage after closing.
